**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the routing-time role for READONLY retries**

When a topology refresh completes while an async command is awaiting its reply, `NodesManager.set_nodes()` changes the existing `ClusterNode.server_type` in place; an in-flight write that was routed to a primary can therefore reach this check after the node has been changed to `REPLICA`. The resulting `ReadOnlyError` is not marked retryable, so the command fails even though the refreshed slot cache can now route it to the promoted primary (whereas a sync full refresh replaces the node object). Capture the role before issuing/awaiting the command, or use the routing/cache state rather than this mutable field.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document READONLY in the refresh and retry contract**

This branch adds another error-triggered topology refresh and consumes the cluster retry budget, but both public `RedisCluster` constructor docstrings still describe `cluster_error_retry_attempts`, `retry`, and `topology_refresh_min_interval` using trigger lists that omit READONLY. In particular, callers are not told that this failure is paced by `topology_refresh_min_interval`; update the sync and async docstrings alongside the behavior change.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Mark the sync READONLY tests as fixed-client tests**

These three sync tests construct their own mocked `RedisCluster` and thus pin the client configuration, but unlike their async mirrors they have no `fixed_client` mark. The suite definitions in `tasks.py:109-178` select that mark for the one-off fixed-client run and exclude it from the standalone/cluster matrix, so the tests are absent from their intended suite and instead run redundantly under matrix configurations they do not consume; add `@pytest.mark.fixed_client` to all three.

Hey @pcbeingused333 , thank you for your contribution!

I compared the three open PRs for #4628 (this one, #4633 and #4636) and I am going to continue with #4636. Adding `ReadOnlyError` to `ERRORS_ALLOW_RETRY` makes the retry depend only on the error type, so a `READONLY` from a node the client has cached as a replica (for example a write sent with `target_nodes=RedisCluster.REPLICAS`) now triggers a topology refresh and is retried with backoff before the same error is raised. The fix should apply only when the node is cached as a primary. Non-transactional pipelines also still neither refresh nor retry on `READONLY`, so a pipeline of keyless writes keeps failing. #4636 checks the cached role in one helper and covers commands and pipelines on both stacks.

I am closing this PR in favor of #4636. Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the review rounds.
